item.title: Prompt Engineering for Authentic Historical Photo Restoration
item.description:
Prompt Engineering for Authentic Historical Photo Restoration

Prompt engineering plays an important role in AI-assisted restoration.

Small wording changes can dramatically affect the final image.

Weak Prompt

Restore this old photograph.

This leaves many important decisions to the model.

Strong Prompt

A better prompt specifies:

  • Damage detection
  • Identity preservation
  • Background reconstruction
  • Texture fidelity
  • Period accuracy
  • Composition preservation

This produces far more reliable results.

Key Instructions

Always include guidance such as:

  • Do not alter facial identity.
  • Do not change pose.
  • Preserve original framing.
  • Preserve clothing.
  • Preserve medals and decorations.
  • Avoid AI-art styling.
  • Avoid over-sharpening.
  • Maintain original textures.

item.title: Mastering JSON Prompting for AI Video Generation
item.description:
Mastering JSON Prompting for AI Video Generation

Artificial intelligence video models are becoming increasingly capable, but achieving consistent, high-quality results still depends on how well you communicate your ideas. One of the most effective ways to do this is through structured JSON prompts.

Instead of writing one long paragraph describing a scene, JSON divides your prompt into logical sections. Each section controls a specific part of the final output, making prompts easier to understand, edit, reuse, and automate.

item.title: How to Build a $100/Day AI Income Machine in 48 Hours Using Only Your Phone
item.description:
How to Build a $100/Day AI Income Machine in 48 Hours Using Only Your Phone

Challenge

Budget: $0

Equipment: One smartphone

Followers: None

Paid Ads: None

Goal: Earn your first $100 per day using AI.

Introduction

Artificial Intelligence has dramatically reduced the amount of work required to create valuable digital services. Tasks that once took hours can now be completed in minutes.

This creates an opportunity for individuals with limited resources. Instead of spending months building a social media audience or investing money into advertising, you can use AI to solve problems for people who are already willing to pay.
